notes.title: The first player has beaten the game on the hard difficulty level.
notes.content:
We have been very impressed with a game passing speed and skills of player Ume. Having spent about 4 hours to beat the game on the easy level this player has got to the top. After 6 hours he has beaten our internal record set by the tester 0xFFFFFFFF. Therefore we decided to present to Ume a small gift.
Have a good game!

notes.title: Free HD DLC
notes.content: At the start of sales many players shared with us their opinions about the graphics level in the game. We agree that the game is worthy of better graphics and right now we are starting working at a free addition for Space Xonix, which is going to lead the graphics up to a modern level and let enjoy playing even to very picky connoisseurs.
